d:
Insidious: Out of the Further is the sixth movie in the Insidious franchise. But after loving the first two films, the real question is simple: is Insidious 6 still scary?
In this episode of First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews and analyses Insidious: Out of the Further, breaking down the good, the bad and everything in between to decide whether this latest Insidious movie is worth watching in theatres.
